document:654.text:
Name: Uma
Gender: Female
Age: 5
Cause of Death: Starvation
Life History: Her father died in a mining accident when she was three. The Second Divine War broke out when she was four, forcing Uma and her mother to flee their village. Her mother died of illness when Uma was five. With no one left to care for her, Uma starved to death soon afterward.
Personal Effects: Heavily patched clothing, one blanket, and a tattered cloth pouch containing chewed tree bark.

姓名：乌玛
性别：女
年龄：5岁
死因：饥饿而亡
生前经历：3岁时，父亲死于矿难；4岁时，第二次神魔大战爆发，乌玛和她母亲所生活的村庄受到战火波及，开始流亡；5岁时，她的母亲因病去世，之后不久，无人照料的乌玛因饥饿而死亡。
随身物品：一身打满补丁的衣服，一条毯子，一个破布口袋，口袋里装着咀嚼过的树皮
